A lower-resource automated system might be acceptable if it’s voluntary and transparent—but it must not replace human connection. Predictive models should enhance trust and autonomy rather than override them.

Student choice should drive the design of these systems—predictive models shouldn’t make decisions alone but inform them, ensuring every student feels seen as an individual.
